newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico crude port Pajaritos opens, Dos Bocas shut.
newsitem.headline: Mexico crude port Pajaritos opens, Dos Bocas shut.

text.p: Mexico crude port Pajaritos reopened at 1100 local/1700 GMT on Friday as wind speeds relaxed, but Dos Bocas port remained closed as winds increased to about 65 km per hour, port officials told Reuters.
Pajaritos in Veracruz state and Dos Bocas in Tabasco state along the Gulf of Mexico have been closed off and on this week for a total of four days shut.

A cold front moving southeast along the gulf has been closing ports and threatens to continue through the weekend, said a Dos Bocas port official, who said weather conditions causing waves of 14 feet high were expected to worsen overnight.
Mexico's third and largest crude port, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, remained operating throughout the week, despite winds in the region of between 35 and 45 km per hour.
